children: Treasury yields rise as markets face geopolitical uncertainty and brace for interest rate increases amid a lull in economic indicators. China's Xi Jinping visits the U.S. Brent crude rises 1%, back to $100 a barrel, following President Trump's threat to escalate the war in Iran if Tehran fails to accept a deal. Hawkish Fedspeak supports bets on a sequence of hikes into 2027. The 10-year yield rises to 4.988% from yesterday's settlement of 4.966% and the two-year increases to 4.796% from 4.749%.
